parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPv4 gateways that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的IPv4网关列表信息的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC associated with the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的IPv4网关实例关联的VPC的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query
parameters.name: ipv4_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的IPv4网关实例的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipv4_gateway_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IPv4 gateway belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
